scope: First-step boundary/large-field payment ledger for the original source law. Historical theorem/assumption scope and one original P0 defect mechanism separated. No new UV/global result, independent source-proof audit or new paper.

source_boundary_ledger.item: B_k is a sum over scales and connected localization domains meeting the relevant large-field set. The source assumes/propagates a local activity bound B0 exp(-kappa d_j(X)) on its multi-scale analytic class U_j(X,alpha0,alpha1). The class includes plaquette/current/local-gauge conditions, not a plaquette cutoff alone.

Existence of constants and propagation of ALL inductive assumptions require the coupling recursion and many earlier/new parameter restrictions. Reading this statement does not independently check all those restrictions or prove its induction.

The activity decay pays the domain sum, then the scale sum. The displayed total B bound is proportional to a sum of coarse counts |Gamma_n|; the source then retains the negative Wilson action, logarithmic terms and an O(1) count cost. These are not a volume-independent boundary constant or a universal surface-area bound.

UV stability bounds are stated under Theorem1, uniform in eta and total lattice T, but their constants depend on the effective coupling g_k. This is a historical literature result; it is not a new mass-gap/continuum result or a verified coupling-uniform normalizer.

completion_square_allocation.original1621_identity: 1.26 retains +1/2 h^T C_I h and the shifted interaction/indicator expectation. The positive square cannot be charged to B^(1) without an estimate, nor dropped because Q has a gap.
completion_square_allocation.available_exact_check: When recombined with the ORIGINAL exterior Gaussian quadratic, -1/2 a_O^T Q_OO a_O+1/2 h^T Q_II^-1 h=-1/2 a_O^T(Q_OO-Q_OI Q_II^-1 Q_IO)a_O. This is the positive Schur-complement exterior precision for the same full positive Q.
completion_square_allocation.limit: This identity preserves the quadratic cost; it does not bound the nonlinear shifted activity, original indicators, Jacobians or normalizer reciprocals. It is not permission to replace a changed-background Q by the original one.

defect_family_separation.P0: Original1.1 fine-plaquette bad cubes: at least one actual fine plaquette violates epsilon0=g0*A0*(log g0^-2)^p in each P0 cube.
defect_family_separation.P1: Original1.4 localized-minimizer plaquette defects. A bad localized minimizer is not by definition a bad ORIGINAL fine plaquette; a quantitative variational/energy or event-comparison step is needed.
defect_family_separation.R1: Original1.18 raw-fluctuation bad cubes. These require the actual conditional quadratic/interaction/mean analysis and source support; their suppression cannot be inferred merely by counting P0.
defect_family_separation.source_S1: The retained boundary sets and final Lambda1 involve these families and prescribed geometric enlargements. Setting P1/R1 or their transported indicators aside would change the original decomposition.

P0_payment_check.real_action: For real unitary fine links, the original normalized Wilson plaquette term controls c_W*||U(dp)-I||_*^2 with a positive fixed trace/norm conversion c_W. This uses the real compact group, not independent complex variables.
P0_payment_check.counting: Assign one violating plaquette to each disjoint original P0 cube. Shared-boundary multiplicity is at most a fixed nu. Then g0^-2 S_W>=c_W*A0^2*q^(2p)*N_P0/nu, q=log g0^-2.
P0_payment_check.source_geometry: Source R0 is the smallest L-power >=q^r, so for q>=1, R0<L*q^r. A fixed-layer neighborhood of the original LM2R0 cubes has at most C_geom*(M2 R0)^4*N_P0 lattice sites at fixed L,M2,d=4. This concerns that actual P0 neighborhood, not the whole final large-field region generated also by P1/R1.
P0_payment_check.conservative_budget: A cost <=C_cost*(1+q) per such site is <=C_prime*q^(4r+1)*N_P0 for q>=1, including a deliberately conservative logarithmic measure allowance. No numerical C_cost is extracted from the source here.
P0_payment_check.comparison: The declared source p>=5r,r>=2 gives 2p-(4r+1)>=6r-1>0. Thus for fixed matched constants sufficiently small original g0 lets the actual Wilson penalty dominate this P0-local count/log cost, leaving a positive defect penalty. No favorable change of the first threshold is made.
P0_payment_check.scope: This verifies the exponent mechanism for the original fine-plaquette defect family, not all-defect entropy summability or full UV stability. epsilon0 is not identified with the separate raw delta0 cutoff; the historical raw prefactor issue remains.

decision: Keep the full source B^(1) estimate as a literature theorem under its genuine hypotheses, not a new independent achievement. The explicit P0 payment cannot stand in for P1/R1 energy estimates or the full boundary/marked/history transfer. No fresh review, score, paper or global claim is justified.
falsifiers: A source cost has more than the declared polynomial/log budget or constants are not fixed uniformly over the claimed family
One P0 defect is counted many times beyond the bounded original cube/plaquette multiplicity
A localized-minimizer or raw-fluctuation defect is silently reclassified as a P0 Wilson defect
The completed-square term is retained without its original exterior action or interactions are discarded
The real Wilson positivity is used on independent complex configurations
Coupling-dependent UV stability constants are advertised as uniform in coupling
